negative_reviews.author: Christie Conway
negative_reviews.text: I never write reviews but this service honestly ruined my meal with my bf. The food is really good however the woman -supervisor/manager on shift was so rude. She physically laughed at people whose card declined the first time next to us and then walked around the restaurant giving them glares even when they walked out. She did not seem to care at all and slammed our food down in front of us.There were a few times when people went to get her attention as she hadn’t checked on the tables she seated and she just glared at them and walked past. The restaurant atmosphere and food were really good but her attitude just ruined it and as an ex hospitality worker it really bothered me, like I’m aware we all have a bad day but other people on the tables next to us noticed this as well. I don’t think we will be going there again

negative_reviews.author: Dana Jones
negative_reviews.text: We visited the restaurant around 2 in the afternoon yesterday, it seemed not to busy, we were looking forward to have our usual, but our experience was ruined by the servers. The waitress seemed in a rush to take the order and was difficult to approach for any help and was evidently uninterested. Later our Ramen arrived on table and we were missing a chilli oil on one of the ramens we requested a man with glasses to get us some but he completely ignored our request and got busy chatting, had to ask him again to get us some but by then our ramen had gone cold. Overall the food has been nice last couple of times but this time the experience was ruined because of clearly rude and uninterested staff. Not going back anytime soon
